protocol.name: platinum_shell_v1
protocol.description: Lets Platinum 2026's own programs (the Finder, control panels) tell platinum-wm how to frame a window, e.g. as a movable modal dialog, when the generic rule (fixed size with a parent window) can't apply.

entry.name: movable_modal
entry.summary: dialog: title bar without boxes, no resize box

request.name: set_window_style

description.summary: choose the frame for a toplevel's surface

request.description: Applies to the xdg_toplevel (or X11 window) whose surface this is, now or once it maps. Lasts until the surface is destroyed.

request.name: set_window_position
request.description: Spatial programs (the Finder) reopen windows where the user left them. Applies when the toplevel maps; x and y are the frame's top-left in layout coordinates, kept on screen by the compositor.

event.name: window_position
event.description: Sent to the surface's own client when its toplevel maps and whenever it is moved or resized, with the frame's top-left in layout coordinates.

event.name: active_client
event.description: Sent on bind and whenever the window with keyboard focus changes, with the process id of the program that owns it (an X11 window's own process, not Xwayland's), or 0 when no window is in front. The menu bar uses it to show that program's own menus (global menus).

request.name: begin_launch

description.summary: show launch feedback until the application is ready

request.description: Cookie identifies a launch on this binding. The compositor ends feedback when a matching application maps or activates a window, or after 15 seconds. PID may be zero for D-Bus activation; app_id is the desktop entry ID, or empty when unknown. At most 32 launches may be pending.

request.name: update_launch

description.summary: supply the PID after spawning the application

request.description: Updates an existing launch. Completed or cancelled cookies are ignored.

request.name: cancel_launch
request.description: Unknown or already completed cookies are ignored.

event.name: active_gtk_menu

description.summary: GTK menu exports of the focused surface

event.description: Sent on bind, focus changes and menu-property changes. Empty strings clear the current GTK menu. Window paths distinguish windows owned by the same process. The bus name is the client's unique D-Bus name.
